fact: Ecofin reports (published 2026-03-16) that Chad's Digital Code, under development since December 2025, incorporates international standards on cybersecurity and data protection.
Minister Boukar Michel announced on 2025-12-09 that authorities are finalizing a new digital law incorporating international standards on cybersecurity, data protection and internet governance.
source_slug: 2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards

fact: The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records that Chad signed the Malabo Convention on 2015-06-14 and had not ratified it.
The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis applies Loi n°007/PR/2015 to personal data, including transfers abroad under articles 29 to 32.
ACTPOL, citing the African Union status list of 2 February 2026, says Chad has signed the Malabo Convention without ratifying it.
